About this study and wardrobe

The room follows the 77 original faces in your matching SketchUp files: the full-height wardrobe at the left, glass-front book storage and three drawers in the middle, side-opening bookshelves and study desk at the right. The loft is shuttering only.

External shutters and drawer fronts are handleless beige matte; exposed shelving, the desk and its side panel are walnut-brown matte. Wardrobe compartments, book storage and open bookshelves and bonsai niche include concealed strip lighting. The side shelves hold books; the tall narrow front-facing niche beside the glass shutter contains a potted bonsai.

Reference colours show your supplied geometry. Stored items and internal shelf spacing illustrate the arrangements you selected. Final measurements are subject to site confirmation. Finishes save in this browser; quotation prices have not been added.
